resources.string: Zzitto lets you dictate in any app. Tap a text field: the microphone icon appears. Tap the icon to speak and again to stop (it also stops by itself after a pause). The text is corrected and inserted into the field. Long press the icon to cancel or change language, translation or mode. The cards at the top show what is still needed. Everything happens on the phone: no audio and no text leaves the device.
The tour walks you through the required steps: accessibility service, microphone, battery, model preparation and your first dictation. You can repeat it at any time from Settings.

Choose the language, correction mode (Faithful, Clean, Formal), translation into English or Spanish, how much silence stops listening, the maximum length, voice commands, the vibration or sound cue and the microphone to use (phone, wired, USB or Bluetooth headset; if the chosen one is not connected the system default is used). \"Free memory after\" sets how many idle minutes before the models leave RAM: the next dictation then takes a few seconds longer.
Add names, companies and technical terms you want spelled correctly. The words help both transcription and correction. The list is stored encrypted on the phone.
A shortcut links a keyword to a text. If you dictate only the keyword (for example \"signature\"), Zzitto inserts the linked text as is, without correction. Shortcuts are stored encrypted.

History keeps your latest dictations (original and corrected text), encrypted on the phone. You can turn it off, choose how many days to keep it and delete everything with one tap. Tap an entry to see the original text.
Zzitto only uses open source components with permissive licenses (MIT, Apache 2.0, BSD). Here is the full list with the license texts.

Zzitto is free for 30 days. After that, dictation stops until you unlock the app with a one-time purchase, no subscription. During the trial the app contacts Google Play only to check the purchase; after purchasing it no longer needs the network. If you reinstall the app, use \"Restore purchase\".

Zzitto transcribes what you say, removes hesitations and repetitions, fixes punctuation and types the text into the field you are using, in any app. Your keyboard stays the same. All the artificial intelligence runs on the phone: no audio and no text leaves the device. Let\'s set everything up in a few steps.
Zzitto uses the microphone only while you dictate, after you tap the icon. The audio stays in memory and is deleted right after transcription: it is never saved.

On Samsung phones power saving can close the Zzitto service. Open the app info, tap Battery and choose \"Unrestricted\". Alternatively: Settings → Device care and battery → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Zzitto.
The transcription and correction models are downloaded with the app. On first launch Zzitto prepares them in internal storage and checks their integrity. Keep the app open until the bar is full.

Tap the field below: the microphone icon appears. Tap it, say for example \"uhm, tomorrow at ten I have a meeting, no, at eleven\" and pause. The icon color shows the state: red listening, orange transcribing, purple correcting, green inserting.
To show the microphone icon when you tap a text field and to type the text you dictate into it, Zzitto needs Android\'s accessibility service.
detects which text field is active and where it is on the screen;
inserts the dictated text into that field;
reads the text you select, only when you ask to rewrite it by voice.
Zzitto does not read the rest of the screen, does not log what you type on your keyboard, and does not store or send anyone other apps\' content. Everything stays on your phone.
You can turn the service off at any time in Android settings. Without it you cannot dictate in other apps.
Dictation in other apps is not active. You can reopen the disclosure at any time, here or from Settings.
